correctness.rationale: All eight vectors satisfy unit norm and exact degree-at-most-three spherical moments; discrete Minkowski gives the specified facets. Cauchy brightness gives eight zonotope generators πu/4. The 56 3-minors partition exhaustively into 8 same-ring, 16 opposite-pair and 32 adjacent-pair types with signed cases resolved on the fundamental twist domain. Sum of absolute determinants equals 64(1+cos d+sin d)/(3√3), proving the full volume formula, endpoints, uniqueness modulo quarter-turn symmetry and endpoint variation. Exact rational minors (224), 20 moment equations at four twists and five independent hull volumes were verified by the included check.py; these experiments do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A canonical one-parameter family of eight-normal spherical three-designs shares all moments through degree three and the same surface area, yet its projection-body volume changes by an exact 20.71 percent. The formula and complete minimax twist classification provide an interpretable metric separation between finite-design isotropy and nonlinear projection geometry, including a linear cusp at aligned rings and quadratic stability at maximal twist.
